answer: Temporal activity horizon matching. After the fact, cluster accounts by their burst timing across tasks; honest agents show a walnut-shaped spread of activity over a long horizon, while sybils fire in synchronized batches. Each cluster must also pass a vault check: funds moved in lockstep across members reveal shared control. Enforcement voids rewards for flagged clusters and requires re-earning trust. Attackers pay per-identity costs to stagger timing and split funding, scaling with fleet size and defeating batch efficiency.
